name: prone-right
prompt: Production animation sheet of the exact USER-APPROVED mean vicious giant rat in the supplied reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT a layout to copy. Lean wiry quadruped, narrow angular muzzle, small narrowed predatory dark eyes, small rounded ragged ears, sharp natural rat incisors, coarse bristling brown-gray fur, muted pink-brown paws/ears and long bare segmented tail. Four paws only. Detailed shaded textured hand-painted retro dungeon game art; muted earthy palette, crisp edges, warm neutral light. Keep rat mean and nasty, never cute, fluffy, plump or baby-faced. RIGHT PROFILE facing image RIGHT, nose pointing RIGHT and rump on LEFT. Full long rat tail curves on ground behind rump, never in front of nose. Exactly ONE full-body pose on a landscape sheet, centered with generous transparent margins. PRONE / SLEEPING pose. Rat lying fully low on its SIDE, eyes closed, head on the invisible ground, limp folded or loosely extended paws and relaxed tail. Clearly lower than its standing rat height, body long and low, no upright sitting. Keep anatomy and world scale, never a plump curled ball. Preserve named viewing direction: FRONT head toward viewer, BACK head directed away with rump nearest viewer, profiles nose to specified side. No blood/gore. Each complete rat INCLUDING ENTIRE TAIL must fit inside its OWN cell with at least 12% transparent margin on every edge and a fully transparent gutter between cells; never overlap or touch. Keep body/paw registration stable. OPAQUE RAT ON GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: every background pixel must have alpha 0. Absolutely NO colored brown haze, glow, vignette, gradient backdrop, floor or cast shadow. No text, labels, borders, grid lines or reference turnaround layout. Preserve source detail and complete whiskers, ears, paws and tails.
